root_cause: The installed helper fetches origin main without a destination refspec, then checks out origin/main. Git 1.8.3.1 refreshes FETCH_HEAD but not that tracking reference for this command. A remote append therefore leaves the helper repeatedly building on stale origin/main; pushes are rejected.
